design_risks.risk: Overshoot obstacle then reverse into back-side landing may only be G02 brake-under-ledge adaptation.
design_risks.action: Require different actual player decision or label useful adapter; compare no-shot/free-drop/reversed aim before novelty claim.

design_risks.risk: Downward recoil under a nose can be bypassed by walking/dropping or a later ordinary jump.
design_risks.action: Test freefall, zero-shot, forward-shot, early oblique jump; accept meaningful same-core alternatives.

design_risks.risk: Shore pre-start/pre-park made descending carrier a static stepping stone in prior17-case actual run.
design_risks.action: Known three downstream-recoil pre-park timings are mandatory regression cases before new admission.

design_risks.risk: Original multiport physicalKeys omit reward_sites; workshop export adds only first route rewards.
design_risks.action: Isolated new producer must assert identical reward_sites as well as physical cells/mechanism initial states across routes.

design_risks.risk: Several port markers with all extra relations UNKNOWN provide no actual branch choice.
design_risks.action: At least same physical ingress has verified alternative exits; four-port candidate should declare which are branch/recovery/return. All other pairs remain UNKNOWN.

design_risks.risk: Independent endpoint fresh full-resource scenes do not prove continuous return.
design_risks.action: Preserve freshSceneAtSourcePort=true and returnStateChaining=false unless a separate unreset continuous witness binds actual prior exit state.

checks_for_final_review: All new version identities absent from baseline44.

Every asserted multiport pair matches route direction and source/target actual support.
N*(N-1) directed relations, no inferred port interchangeability.
Same local physics/reward/initial world per multiport route; validate no hidden seam repair.
